system_settings.description: Configure coordinator-owned Firewalla runtime settings. Lower intervals (1m) provide faster updates but increase load on the Firewalla local API. Watched-device online windows can be as low as 3 minutes, but only make sense when the polling interval is shorter than that. Device-tracker away windows must be at least 5 minutes and usually work best at roughly double the polling interval or more. Network status entities expose one connectivity binary sensor per Firewalla network (LAN/VLAN/VPN/WAN) with addressing, advanced options, and usage details.

wan_uuid.description: Use the Firewalla WAN UUID for deterministic automations.

wan_name.name: WAN name (Optional)
wan_name.description: Use the WAN display name shown by Firewalla. If only one WAN is available, you can omit both WAN selectors.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry ID (Optional)
config_entry_id.description: Use this if you have more than one Firewalla setup. It targets one specific setup.

config_entry_name.name: Config entry name (Optional)
config_entry_name.description: Use this if you have more than one Firewalla setup and they each have unique names. If names repeat, use Config Entry ID.

pause_rule_control_only.name: Pause rule (control only)
pause_rule_control_only.description: Experimental. Pause one managed Firewalla rule using only the rule ID and pause control fields in the update payload. Provide either a duration or a resume time. If you provide neither, the rule stays paused until resumed.

rule_target.name: Rule target
rule_target.description: Enter the Rule ID shown on a Firewalla rule switch, or a selected rule ID from the runtime inventory for this Firewalla setup.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Optional. How long to pause the rule, for example 30m, 4h, or 2d 4h 30m.

resume_at.name: Resume at
resume_at.description: Optional. A local date and time when the rule should resume.

config_entry_name.name: Config entry name (Optional)
config_entry_name.description: Use this if you have more than one Firewalla setup and they each have unique names. If names repeat, use Config Entry ID.

resume_rule.name: Resume rule
resume_rule.description: Resume one managed Firewalla rule immediately.

set_ssid_paused.name: Set SSID paused
set_ssid_paused.description: Pause or resume one AP7 wireless network (SSID profile).

ssid_profile_id.name: SSID profile
ssid_profile_id.description: The UUID or SSID name of the wireless network to toggle. Get the list from the get_wireless_status service.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Set to true to enable (unpause) the wireless network, or false to pause it.

get_wireless_status.name: Get wireless status
get_wireless_status.description: Returns the current wireless configuration (SSID profiles and access points) as structured data. SSID profiles include the SSID, band, encryption, paused state, VLAN, and interface. Access points include the name, model, channels, and LED state. For Firewalla boxes without AP7 access points, the returned sections are empty.
